protocol.model: LightGBM point model (squared loss) on window summaries
protocol.search_data: fit engines only; validation engines = the 15% of fit engines held out for early stopping by training seed 0; calibration and test engines never read during the search
protocol.objective: validation RMSE (cycles, capped truth) of a model trained on the other fit engines, trees early-stopped on the validation engines (patience 100, cap 2000)
protocol.sampler: TPE (seed 0); trial 0 = default recipe; no pruning
protocol.final: run-all protocol for the LightGBM point model: seeds [0, 1, 2], each with its own early-stopping engines; split conformal (alpha 0.1) on the calibration engines; decisions from the point prediction; one evaluation on the official test engines
protocol.bootstrap: 2000 paired resamples of test engines (seed-mean difference, tuned - default); validation: resamples of validation engines

parallel_runs.note: subsets run as separate processes at the same time; total = wall clock
